changelog: Fixes from walking the install as a stranger. The install line is now npx slashvibe-mcp setup, which works from a terminal or when your agent runs it. Setup always prints the sign-in link. --help shows help instead of starting setup. Opening a line is checked: trust needs you signed in, refuses a handle /vibe does not know, and tells you who it is first. The server no longer writes message text to its log.
features: Install with npx slashvibe-mcp setup; the bare command with no terminal says so instead of doing nothing
Setup prints the sign-in link while it waits, for when no browser opened
npx slashvibe-mcp help | --version; an unknown command on a terminal shows the commands instead of running setup
trust @handle: requires sign-in, takes exactly one well-formed handle, refuses one /vibe does not know, and names who it is before the line opens
The server no longer logs message text; start-up diagnostics only with VIBE_DEBUG
After install, the first words are: what's waiting on /vibe
